#The Sacrament

They say you can summon an assassin with a ritual: a heart, skulls, nightshade, a knife and a prayer to the Night Mother. They say she hears.

I know a man who tried it, as a joke, at a party. He was found the next morning with a note pinned to his coat that said only: Not a joke.

#The Tenets

The Brotherhood keeps five old laws: never dishonor the Night Mother, never betray the family, never disobey the Speaker, never steal from a brother, never kill a brother. Break any, and the Wrath of Sithis follows.

They say the newer Brotherhood keeps fewer laws than that. They say a lot of things.

#The Door

Every Sanctuary has a black door with a skull on it, and the door asks a question. If you know the answer, it opens. If you don't, nothing happens.

Nothing at all, the first time.
